Subject: Meridian CAIQ intake — initial control mapping & evidence ask

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for agreeing to assist with our CAIQ intake. We've completed a first-pass of the questionnaire and flagged ~40 controls where we need explicit evidence from Redwood. The highest priority items for our auditor team are controls tied to:
- Key management and HSM/KMS attestations (KMS-1, KMS-2)
- Tenant isolation and virtualization boundaries (TEN-3, NET-4)
- Runtime telemetry and log preservation (LOG-1, LOG-3)
- Data encryption in transit and at rest (ENC-2, ENC-4)

Can you confirm an ownership map (who owns each control) and provide a short evidence bundle (samples, playbooks, or log snippets) for the above? We aim to begin a walkthrough with our auditor (Cc'd) the week of Jun 10 if possible.

Attached: Meridian_CAIQ_Request_2028.xlsx (questionnaire export with flags).

Thanks —
Sam R.
Manager, InfoSec — Meridian Health

Kimberly / team —

Attaching the first-draft CAIQ mapping and an evidence index for Meridian. Notes below on scope and exclusions.

Attachments: caiq_mapping_meridian.json (control -> artifact map), evidence_index_meridian.pdf (table of artifacts + owners)

Summary of approach:
- We exported the CAIQ CSV and mapped controls to our internal control registry. The mapping file contains the attributed subcontrols and the primary evidence link. Example snippet:
  * CCM-ENC-2 -> evidence: /drive/redwood/enc/at-rest-key-rotation.pdf (owner: Priyom Das)
  * CCM-TEN-3 -> evidence: /drive/redwood/tenancy/tenant-segmentation-arch.png (owner: Marcus Lin)

- Evidence is deliberately conservative: we provided redacted log snippets and architecture diagrams rather than full keys or raw logs. Live key material is not included (HSM attestations are summarized with KMS export IDs and SOC references).

Open items (action required):
1) Marcus: provide a 1-page runtime isolation narrative and a sample tenant-attach/detach log for TEN-3.
2) Laura: assemble a single zip with PDFs/screenshots and add index IDs that match the mapping file.
3) Kimberly: confirm that the auditor can accept redacted logs and that we are okay gating any deeper requests to the legal team.

Evidence staging links (internal):
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-meridian-caiq
- Internal snippet repo: https://internal.redwood/caiq-snippets/meridian (requires SSO)

I'll also create a short runbook describing how we generated the log excerpt (timestamp range, redaction rules).

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
